name: Patrika AI Generated Articles API
description:
API to ingest AI-generated articles.

This API accepts MULTIPLE articles in a single request.

Rules:
- Maximum 5 articles per request
- Images are allowed ONLY as Base64
- Image URLs inside post_content are NOT allowed
- featured_image must be Base64 only
- Text-only content is allowed
- Rate limit: 1 request per 10 seconds
